_doc: Items the deletion census flags that are read by something other than our code. Key = the census key (env:<railway service>:<NAME> or table:<app>:<name>). The value is the reason, with a receipt. A key whose item stops being flagged, or stops existing, is reported as STALE. Remove it then. Never add a key here just to quiet a finding: prove the reader first.

keep.env:MAINnicks-tire-auto:RAILPACK_DEPLOY_: read by Railway's Railpack builder, not by app code: it installs these apt packages into the deploy image (railway.ts builder: RAILPACK)
keep.env:statenour-web:AUTH_URL: read implicitly by Auth.js v5 (next-auth ^5 in apps/statenour/package.json), which takes AUTH_URL from the environment without a code reference
keep.env:statenour-web:AUTH_TRUST_HOST: read implicitly by Auth.js v5 (next-auth ^5 in apps/statenour/package.json) to trust the proxy's Host header behind Railway
